name: Hirono Mist-Walker Plush Pendant
checklist: Verify the box QR through Pop Mart's official verification page before paying secret-tier prices.
Confirm the paper character card matches the figure inside — mismatched cards signal a swapped or reboxed pull.
Inspect fur pile density and face paint edges against official product photos; soft or bleeding edges are the common counterfeit tell.
Fakes concentrate in listings priced well under the sealed blind box range and in lots shipped from outside the US.
